A person in dark clothing walks away from the camera past a white storefront with green potted plants and glass windows. Daylight is bright and even. Subtitles remain at the bottom. (3) A male staff member wearing a white collared shirt, dark green apron, and a white face mask stands behind a glass counter. He uses white-gloved hands to present a brown paper bag with illustrated characters. The setting is a clean, bright retail space. Subtitles continue. The lighting is warm and consistent. (7) A hand reaches into a paper bag to pull out a pastry wrapped in a green paper sleeve with "Matcha" printed on it.
